name: Bonanza Billion Merge Up+

features.name: Merging clusters
features.description: Four-symbol clusters pay and merge into higher-level symbols.

features.name: Additive multipliers
features.description: 2x–100x multipliers in free spins add together.

review:
BGaming smashed its two biggest engines together: the Bonanza Billion fruits and the Merge Up mechanic. Four or more adjacent symbols form a cluster, pay, then merge into a higher-level symbol.

Four, five or six scatters give 10, 20 or 30 free spins (three more scatters add five), and that's the only place multipliers show up – 2x to 100x, all added together at the end of a sequence. Very high volatility, 15,000x max and a 97.04% RTP. Free spins are rare though, about once every 386 spins.
pros: Excellent 97.04% RTP – among the highest published
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus is rare (about 1 in 386 spins on average)
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
